task: X11a — the PCM reader off the main thread
question: Does reading the track tap in a worker place the take late? (+14 ms on the first build)
answer: No. The hand-off the stamp corrects is 0.05 ms median / <=1 ms p95, and the product sync band is identical on both arms.

handoff.note: main-thread receipt minus the worker's own stamp, per batch; absent on the main pump where the stamp IS the receipt

oracleSyncBand.note: npm run oracle, 7 cold cells per arm, ONE build, --query=audiotapthread=main is the control arm

whyTheAnchorABCannotAnswerIt.note: rawAnchorMs differencing was the method that blocked this task; it is disproven by its own control
whyTheAnchorABCannotAnswerIt.sameArmControl: scripts/x11a-anchor.mjs --arms=main,main: paired delta -50.3 ms (mic) / -45.3 ms (system audio), pairs -27.8 and -72.8, between cells that differ in nothing
whyTheAnchorABCannotAnswerIt.spreadAcrossAllCells: 19-350 ms on one build, idle machine
whyTheAnchorABCannotAnswerIt.audioDataTimestamp: the system monotonic clock rebased per browser process (107,423 s read against a 107,400 s uptime), so ctx= is how long that browser had been making sound; a take whose audio device was already running anchors ~110 ms later. Consumed only by a console line — nothing downstream reads it. Lead for X14.
